subject.title: Fix dashboard chat run recovery across reconnects

question: Should maintainers keep this stale external branch as the candidate for https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/41064, or ask for a current-main replacement?
rationale: The branch is useful but unmergeable against current main and automation cannot supply the contributor's real behavior proof or decide whether to salvage this old surface after the Control UI/protocol refactors.

options.title: Request contributor refresh
options.body: Ask the contributor to rebase onto current main, port the fix to ui/src/pages/chat and packages/gateway-protocol, address the review findings, and add real Dashboard proof.

options.title: Sponsor replacement PR
options.body: A maintainer or repair lane can open a current-main replacement that credits this PR if the contributor branch remains unrefreshable.

options.title: Close after replacement lands
options.body: Close this PR only after a merged replacement or current-main proof fully covers the linked issue and preserves the contributor context.

recommendation.title: Request contributor refresh
recommendation.body: Ask the contributor to rebase onto current main, port the fix to ui/src/pages/chat and packages/gateway-protocol, address the review findings, and add real Dashboard proof.

likelyOwner.reason: The current affected UI lifecycle is now in the Control UI page architecture refactored in 65e12328aa20, so this is the best routing owner for the branch-refresh choice.
